title: Tersly/Quotes
summary:
"He-he bossed it out of me."
- Tersley to Dante Vale, about how Montehue was able to find the team (The Legacy of Thor )

"Oh my goodness! Out of the frying pan and into the fire!"
- Tersley to Dante Vale (Two Powers Become One )

"Venadek! Venadek! Help!"
- Tersley invoking Venadek (The Legacy of Thor)

"Don't eat me, please!"
- Tersley to Fenris (Two Powers Become One )
